app-check-blocked-message: BiteTribe Business couldn't verify this device with its security check. Check your connection and try again to continue.
password-reset-request-failed-try-again: We couldn't send the reset email. Please try again.
password-reset-requested-check-your-emai: If an account exists for this email, we've sent a password reset link.
something-went-wrong-please-try-again: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin-tool-user-management-description: Find an account, change its roles or subscription tier, and block it from signing in.
admin-users-select-hint: Select an account to manage its roles, subscription tier and access.
admin-users-roles-hint: A role takes effect on the account’s next sign-in, or within an hour on an open session.
admin-users-roles-conflict-hint: An account cannot be both business and staff. Business operates a restaurant; staff is the narrower set of what can be done on one.
admin-users-save-failed: The roles could not be saved. Please try again.
admin-users-tier-reason-placeholder: Why this account’s tier is changing
admin-users-tier-hint: A tier change is a support action. It changes the badge the account sees and grants no capability: nothing in the product is gated on the tier yet. The reason is required and is the only record of the change.
admin-users-tier-save-failed: The subscription tier could not be saved. Please try again.
admin-users-block-hint: Blocking stops the account from signing in. It removes nothing the account has posted — Bites, reviews and restaurants stay exactly as they are, and removing them is a separate action. An open session keeps working until its token expires, up to an hour.
admin-users-block-self-hint: You cannot block the account you are signed in with. Only an operator can unblock one, so there would be no way back in.
admin-users-block-confirm-message: It will not be able to sign in. Nothing it has posted is removed. An open session keeps working for up to an hour.
admin-users-unblock-confirm-message: It will be able to sign in again.
admin-users-block-save-failed: The account access could not be changed. Please try again.
new-version-notification-hint: Announce a released app version to the users of one store. Only press a button once the store actually serves the new build, because the App Store and Google Play clear their review at different times.
new-version-notification-sent: Announced on {{platform}}: sent to {{tokenCount}} installation(s) across {{userCount}} account(s).
new-version-notification-failed: The {{platform}} announcement could not be sent. Check the function logs and try again.
collection-migrations-hint: One-off rewrites that walk a whole collection. Each is idempotent, so a second run is safe and changes nothing that is already correct. They can take a while on a large collection; the button stays disabled until the run reports back.
migration-failed: Failed. Nothing was reported back — check the function logs.
migration-review-timestamps-hint: Gives every review the numeric createdAtTimestamp the threaded review compartment sorts by, derived from the ISO createdAt it already carries. Reviews written before that field existed have only the string.
name: Name
restaurant-selector-search-google-hint: Tap to search online. Add the city for better results, e.g. "Jabri Amman"
restaurant-selector-no-google-results: No places found on Google Maps
prefill-confirm-message: Replace the fields you edited with data from Google?
prefill-error: Could not load place details from Google. Please try again.
description-placeholder: What did you like about this dish, tell us about it!
uploading-keep-app-open: Uploading photo — keep the app open
retry-upload-offline: You’re offline — reconnect to upload this photo
image-upload-retry-failed: We couldn’t start the upload. Please try again.
image-upload-disabled: It seems you are offline. You can still create a bite without an image and add one later when you are back online.
drag-and-drop-not-supported:
Drag & drop is not supported.
Tap to upload or take a photo.
tap-into-box:
Tap into the box to upload
or take a photo.
location-tap-map-to-move-location-manual: Location (tap map to move location manually):
admin-tool-restaurant-candidates-descrip: Verify a clustered candidate into a real restaurant.
admin-tool-bite-places-description: Place names Bites carry that no verified restaurant answers to yet.
admin-tool-new-version-notification-desc: Announce a released app version to one store’s installations.
admin-tool-review-timestamps-backfill-de: Give every review the numeric timestamp the threaded reviews sort by.
admin-tool-bite-address-backfill-descrip: Resolve a street address for a Bite that carries only a position.
admin-tool-restaurant-clustering-descrip: Cluster a Bite into a restaurant candidate.
admin-tool-image-migration-description: Move a Bite’s inline image into Storage.
admin-tool-geohash-migration-description: Give a Bite the geohash the proximity queries index on.
image-migration-hint: Moves a Bite’s inline base64 image into Storage and repoints the document at the uploaded object.
no-image-migration-eligible-bites: No Bites need an image migration.
geohash-migration-hint: Derives the geohash the proximity queries index on from the position the Bite already carries.
no-geohash-migration-eligible-bites: No Bites are missing a geohash.
admin-tool-bite-search-description: Find a Bite by its name or a tag, and see what BiteTribe holds about it.
admin-users-filter-placeholder: Filter by email, display name or user ID
admin-bites-search-failed: The search failed. This is not the same as finding nothing — try again.
admin-bites-start-hint: Search for a Bite by its name or one of its tags.
admin-bites-no-results: No Bite matches that name or tag.
admin-bites-capped: Showing the first 20 matches. Narrow the term if the Bite you want is not among them.
admin-bites-select-hint: Select a Bite to see what BiteTribe holds about it.
admin-bites-detail-hint: Read-only: only the author can edit a Bite. An operator can only remove it.
admin-bites-delete-reason-placeholder: Why this Bite has to come down
admin-bites-delete-hint: The Bite is deleted outright, together with its image, its reactions and its reviews. It cannot be restored, and the author is not told. The reason is required because the log is the only record.
admin-bites-delete-confirm-message: The Bite, its image, its reactions and its reviews are removed for good. Nothing can be restored.
admin-bites-delete-failed: The Bite could not be deleted. It is still there — try again.
